items.headline: Albemarle has surprising new reason to rally
items.snippet: Battery storage changes Albemarle's lithium equation; Q2 realized lithium price up 61% to $19.53/kg; Energy Storage adj. EBITDA +229% to $723M.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral with an unchanged $130 price target. Strong BESS demand has tipped the market balance into favorable territory.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered PT to $135 from $230, keeps Buy. Lithium price up ~67% YoY but below highs; supply/demand poised to improve into 2027.
